criteria: (1) reads in 3/4 top-down at 1x; (2) same game as Beodeul reference (palette, density, 4-6 shading steps, material-tone dark edges, no toy/flat look); (3) seamless joins, no 16px repeat; (4) reads as purpose and theme. Blind: only PNG paths and criteria given.
count_rule: a major counts when at least 2 of 4 reviewers raise the same problem as a major

earth.ore_vein.A1: 1 counted major: not set into the rock, sticker/glitter on a patch (opus-b, argon major; opus-a, opus-c minor)
earth.ore_vein.A2: 1 counted major: pale streak reads as bones/feathers/sticker (4/4)

earth.overgrown.A1: counted majors: raised block stack, not a flat floor decal; grid/tone do not match the floor (4/4)
earth.overgrown.A2: 0 counted majors (crack reads as a stick: major opus-b only, minor opus-a, opus-c, argon)
